start.title: Avant toutes choses
start.text:
Rien n'existe encore.
Seulement toi — et les ténèbres profondes et infinies.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You wait. The darkness presses closer — patient, heavy.
[TODO:fr] Your hand stretches forward. Something stirs beneath the surface.
[TODO:fr] A sound rises from deep within you — the first sound ever made.

silence.title: Le Grand Silence
silence.text:
Tu attends dans le calme.
Le vide fait mal — il a besoin de quelque chose de plus.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The word gathers inside you — heavy with purpose.
[TODO:fr] Your breath ripples across the deep. Something awakens.

voice.title: La Parole
voice.text:
Ta voix déchire le néant.
Elle porte le poids de l'éternité.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The command explodes from you. There is no turning back.
[TODO:fr] The whisper leaves your lips — soft, yet unstoppable.

void.title: L'Abîme informe
void.text:
Des eaux infinies s'étendent sous toi.
Tu planes au-dessus de l'abîme.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You lower yourself. The water trembles at your presence.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stir the surface with your breath
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your breath moves across the face of the deep.

light.title: Que la lumière soit
light.text:
La lumière jaillit de toi — aveuglante, infinie.
La chaleur inonde le vide pour la première fois.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The light races outward — filling every void.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Shape the light — give it edges
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You cup the light in your hands. It pulses, alive.
[TODO:fr] You draw a line between light and dark. Order begins.

light_obey.title: Que la lumière soit
light_obey.text:
Ton commandement ébranle le vide.
La lumière explose — infinie, aveuglante, vivante.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Warmth gathers around you — golden, tender.
[TODO:fr] The light obeys. It floods the emptiness without end.

light_awe.title: Que la lumière soit
light_awe.text:
La lumière s'élève doucement de ton souffle.
D'abord douce — puis flamboyante, imparable.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You press the light upward — it stretches into sky.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Divide the light from the dark
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Shadow and radiance separate at your touch.

warmth.title: Première Chaleur
warmth.text:
La lumière se transforme en chaleur.
Tu sens la création répondre à ton toucher.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You reach upward. The sky begins to unfold.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Spread your hands — expand it all
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Everything stretches — wider, higher, limitless.

day_night.title: Soir et Matin
day_night.text:
Tu nommes la lumière Jour et les ténèbres Nuit.
Le premier coucher de soleil. La première aube.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You move forward. There is more to create.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Pause — linger in what you've made
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You stop. The colors are yours — and they are beautiful.

sky.title: Les Cieux d'En Haut
sky.text:
Tu étends le ciel comme un rideau.
Les eaux se séparent — au-dessus et en dessous.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Command the dry land to appear
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your voice strikes the deep. The earth begins to rise.
[TODO:fr] The waters obey — drawing inward, making room.
[TODO:fr] You pause. The sky stretches further than you imagined.

sky_vast.title: Le Vaste Ciel
sky_vast.text:
Le bleu s'étend à l'infini dans toutes les directions.
Ta création dépasse même ce que tu avais imaginé.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You speak downward. The ground trembles in answer.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Gather the seas into their places
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The waters rush to their boundaries — eager, wild.

waters_gather.title: Le Rassemblement des Eaux
waters_gather.text:
Tu pousses les océans à leur place.
Les rivières creusent des chemins à ton commandement.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Raise the mountains from the deep
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Stone groans upward. The peaks reach toward you.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Shape the earth with your hands
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You kneel. The soil is warm beneath your fingers.

expanse.title: Le Dôme des Cieux
expanse.text:
Le ciel s'arque comme une cathédrale que tu as bâtie.
Chaque direction contient une promesse.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You look down. The earth rises to meet your gaze.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Press your hands into the earth
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your palms sink into the clay. It yields to you.

land.title: Terre Ferme
land.text:
Les montagnes s'élèvent à ta parole.
Le vert éclate — soudain, sauvage, partout.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Plant a forest with a thought
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Trees spring up — tall, ancient, reaching for your sky.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Craft the first flower by hand
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] A single bloom opens in your palm. Perfect.
[TODO:fr] You ascend. The world unfolds beneath you.

land_emerge.title: La Terre S'élève
land_emerge.text:
La terre ferme se forme sous ton toucher.
Tu sens la terre respirer pour la première fois.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Seeds fall from your hands like rain. Life begins.
[TODO:fr] You watch it grow — slowly, tenderly, from nothing.

plants.title: Le Premier Jardin
plants.text:
Les arbres s'étirent vers le ciel que tu as créé.
Les fruits pendent lourdement — doux, intacts.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Sweetness fills you — your own gift, tasted for the first time.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Wait for darkness — then fill it
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You wait. The empty sky calls to you.

flowers.title: Couleurs Innommées
flowers.text:
Les pétales s'ouvrent à ton toucher.
Des couleurs qu'aucun œil n'a jamais vues — jusqu'à maintenant.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The scent is unlike anything. Because nothing existed before.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Turn your gaze upward — the sky is empty
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The dark sky waits — a canvas, unfinished.

mountain.title: Le Sommet
mountain.text:
Du sommet, tu vois tout ce que tu as fait.
Un ciel vide — attendant d'être rempli.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You reach up. The first star burns in your hand.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Descend — there is more to do
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You climb down. The work is not yet finished.

stars.title: Soleil, Lune et Étoiles
stars.text:
Tu suspends le soleil comme une lampe.
Un millier d'étoiles s'échappent de tes doigts.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The ocean stretches before you — vast, silent, waiting.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Place every star one by one
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Each star finds its place. You name them all.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Set the moon in its place
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Silver rises. The night breathes softly.

stars_delight.title: Soleil, Lune et Étoiles
stars_delight.text:
La douceur persiste — ta création est bonne.
Au-dessus de toi, le ciel attend la lumière.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Fire leaps from your fingers. The sky blazes.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Paint the night sky with silver
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Moonlight pours down — gentle, steady, yours.

stars_vision.title: Soleil, Lune et Étoiles
stars_vision.text:
Du sommet de la montagne, tu lances des étoiles dans l'obscurité.
Chacune une promesse.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] More. More. The darkness shrinks with every throw.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Set the moon to guard the night
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The moon rises — faithful, watching over what you made.

countless_stars.title: Innombrables
countless_stars.text:
Tu les places au-delà de tout compte.
Chacune un pacte — un murmure de ce qui est à venir.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Below, the waters are still. They need life.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Rest a moment beneath your sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You lie back. Your stars shine above you.

moonrise.title: La Lumière Moindre
moonrise.text:
La lumière argentée se répand sur les eaux calmes.
La lune prend sa place — fidèle, silencieuse.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You turn to the deep. It's time to fill it.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Wait for the dawn you designed
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You wait. The horizon glows with approaching light.

sea_dawn.title: Aube sur l'Abîme
sea_dawn.text:
L'aube se lève — ton aube.
Les eaux s'agitent, prêtes à recevoir la vie.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your voice enters the water. Movement begins.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Listen to the silence before it fills
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] One last breath of stillness. Then — everything.

sea_creatures.title: Les eaux grouillent
sea_creatures.text:
Tu remplis les mers — baleines, poissons, essaims de vie.
Les oiseaux jaillissent de tes mains — remplissant le ciel de chants.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Turn to the land — it's still empty
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The ground waits. You have more to give.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Send a bird soaring across the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Wings spread. The bird trusts the wind you made.

bird_flight.title: Premier envol
bird_flight.text:
Les ailes attrapent le vent que tu as créé.
L'oiseau ne connaît pas la peur — seulement le ciel.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Return to the ground — fill it next
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You descend. The earth needs creatures of its own.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Feel the wind on your face
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The breeze you made touches your skin. It's good.

land_creatures.title: Toute chose vivante
land_creatures.text:
Tu parles — lions, cerfs, serpents, insectes apparaissent.
La terre respire de la vie que tu lui as donnée.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Something is still missing — press on
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] A restlessness stirs in you. This isn't finished.
[TODO:fr] They gather around you — warm, trusting, alive.

land_creatures_wind.title: Toute chose vivante
land_creatures_wind.text:
Tu te tiens parmi les créatures — sauvages, chaleureuses, vivantes.
Elles ne fuient pas. Elles connaissent ta voix.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You sit. They press close — unafraid.
[TODO:fr] The ache rises. None of them can truly know you.

among_animals.title: Parmi les créatures
among_animals.text:
Elles se rassemblent autour de toi — confiantes, vivantes.
Mais aucune d'elles ne peut te connaître. Pas vraiment.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Feel the ache of being alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The loneliness deepens. You need someone who understands.
[TODO:fr] You stand. Your hands know what to do.

before_man.title: Le sixième jour
before_man.text:
Tu t'agenouilles dans la poussière.
Tes mains commencent à façonner quelque chose de nouveau — quelque chose à ton image.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your fingers press into the dust. A form takes shape.
[TODO:fr] The words leave your lips. The clay trembles.

before_man_lonely.title: Le sixième jour
before_man_lonely.text:
Le désir s'intensifie — tu veux être connu.
Tu t'agenouilles dans la poussière et commences.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Shape the clay with trembling hands
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your hands shake. This one will be different.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Take your time — this matters most
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You slow down. Every detail matters.

breath_of_life.title: Le souffle de vie
breath_of_life.text:
La poussière devient chair sous tes mains.
Tu te penches — et lui insuffles la vie.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] His eyes open. He sees you first.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Place him gently in the garden
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You carry him — warm, breathing — into paradise.

breath_of_life_sacred.title: Le souffle de vie
breath_of_life_sacred.text:
Ton souffle entre dans l'argile.
Sa poitrine se soulève. Son cœur bat — une fois, deux fois, pour toujours.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You lay him gently on the grass. He stirs.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stand back — let him see the world
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You step away. His eyes open to everything you made.

first_garden.title: Éden
first_garden.text:
Le paradis s'étend devant toi — ton chef-d'œuvre.
Tu regardes tout ce que tu as fait.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Say it — the words that complete it all
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The words rise in you — final, certain.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Sit beside your creation in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You sit. No words needed. It is enough.

first_garden_wonder.title: Éden
first_garden_wonder.text:
Il se tient dans le jardin — vivant, respirant, tien.
Tout — absolument tout — était pour ce moment.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your voice fills the garden — warm, full, complete.
[TODO:fr] You exhale. It is done.

very_good.title: Très bon
very_good.text:
« C'est très bon. »
Tu souris à ton œuvre.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Peace settles over everything.

rest.title: Le septième jour
rest.text:
Tu te reposes. Toute la création respire.
L'histoire ne fait que commencer.

rest_blessed.title: Le septième jour
rest_blessed.text:
Tu te reposes à côté de celui que tu as créé.
La paix remplit chaque recoin de ton monde.
